verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim Spline is 'multiplayer from the ground up' with cloud-hosted files that multiple people can edit simultaneously, shared across both editors. However, there is no explicit mention of live cursors or evidence of independent/hands-on corroboration of real-time sync quality; the community citations are unrelated to collaboration. Missing for 10: explicit live-cursor/presence feature documentation, independent hands-on verification of simultaneous editing and sync latency.
